name: NEUTRONIKA
tip: This level is much faster and longer.
You can deploy four deflectors instead of two.

text: It is done. It is real. It now exists on its own.
The fate of this universe is no longer in our hands.
It is now time for this universe to discover itself.
In time, it will create self-conscious creatures
with the purpose of understanding itself through discovery.
The creatures will need to understand the universe themselves
before explaining it to the universe itself.
Whether they actually make it, it is up to them.
Our work here is done. Now we rest.
